title: Geometry - Lesson 8 Assessment: CPCTC and Theorem Problems
description: Show mastery of using congruent triangles, CPCTC, and related triangle theorems in measure and proof tasks.

questions.question: A proof already established triangle WXY is congruent to triangle ZYX. Which conclusion follows by CPCTC?
options: Angle W is congruent to angle X
questions.explanation: The order WXY congruent to ZYX means W corresponds to Z and X corresponds to Y, so WX corresponds to ZY.

questions.question: Which proof sequence uses CPCTC correctly?
options: Use CPCTC, then prove the triangles congruent
Prove the triangles congruent, then use CPCTC for a corresponding side or angle
Use CPCTC whenever two triangles look equal
Use CPCTC to prove that two right angles exist
questions.explanation: CPCTC is used after triangle congruence has been proven.

questions.question: In triangle ABC, AB is congruent to AC. Which statement follows from the Isosceles Triangle Theorem?
options: Angle A is congruent to angle B
Angle B is congruent to angle C
questions.explanation: The angles opposite the congruent sides AB and AC are angles C and B, so angle B is congruent to angle C.

questions.question: Segment MN joins the midpoints of two sides of triangle PQR. If QR = 34 and MN is parallel to QR, what is MN?
questions.explanation: A midline is half the length of the parallel third side, so MN = 17.

questions.question: HL can be used only when the triangles are right triangles.
questions.explanation: HL is a special congruence theorem for right triangles.

questions.question: If a point lies on the perpendicular bisector of a segment, then it is equidistant from the endpoints of the segment.
questions.explanation: This is the Perpendicular Bisector Theorem.

questions.question: If triangle ABC is congruent to triangle JKL, then angle C corresponds to angle ______.
questions.explanation: The order pairs A with J, B with K, and C with L.

questions.question: Point R lies on the perpendicular bisector of segment ST. If RS = 2x + 5 and RT = 31, then x = ______.
questions.explanation: Set RS = RT: 2x + 5 = 31, so 2x = 26 and x = 13.

questions.question: Given triangle ABD is congruent to triangle CBD, write a valid CPCTC conclusion involving side AD.
questions.correctAnswer: AD is congruent to CD by CPCTC.
questions.explanation: In triangle ABD congruent to triangle CBD, A corresponds to C and D corresponds to D, so AD corresponds to CD.

questions.question: Explain the error: A student writes "angle A is congruent to angle D by CPCTC" before proving any triangles congruent.
questions.correctAnswer: The student used CPCTC too early. CPCTC can only justify corresponding parts after the triangles have already been proven congruent.
questions.explanation: CPCTC is a result of triangle congruence, not a reason for assuming it.
